serverInfo.name: Froggit MCP Connector
serverInfo.title: Froggit MCP Connector
serverInfo.description: Public documentation and product links for Froggit, company memory for people and AI by Frowg Systems. This connector is not the Froggit memory server.

tools.name: forge_buyer_routes
tools.description: Return public Froggit documentation, product, and catalog links.

tools.name: forge_checkout_links
tools.description: Return Froggit's public purchase links. Froggit currently publishes no public offers, so this returns the live offer catalog and contact links.

tools.name: forge_paid_route_for_context
tools.description: Recommend the right Froggit next step (documentation, the public evaluation surface, or sales contact) from buyer context, budget, urgency, and procurement authority signals.

buyer_context.description: Buyer intent, corpus, risk, deployment, or procurement context.

budget_usd.description: Known buyer budget in USD; use 0 when unknown.

urgency_days.description: Days until the buyer needs action; use 0 when unknown.

has_procurement_authority.description: Whether the buyer can approve or influence purchase.

resources.name: Forge buyer routes
resources.description: Public Froggit documentation and product links.

prompts.name: assess_mcp_memory_fit
prompts.description: Assess whether Forge is a fit for an AI agent memory, private RAG, or governed MCP deployment.

arguments.name: context
arguments.description: Deployment context, buyer profile, corpus scope, timeline, risk, or procurement constraints.
